name: Insane HQ Bokeh Blur
aliases: Screen-Space Depth of Field / Tilt-Shift Blur
definition: A screen-space post-processing blur that uses Poisson-disk sampling with a disc kernel to simulate bokeh depth-of-field effects, handling stereo rendering and alpha-weighted accumulation.
summary: Insane HQ Bokeh Blur is a screen-space post-processing technique that simulates depth-of-field using Poisson-disk sampling with spatially varying kernel weights to control blur radius based on screen position.
